سَجِيلٌ , applied to a bucket (دَلْو), Large, or big; as also with ة: (K:) or ↓ سَجِيلَةٌ [alone, i. e. as a subst., rendered such by the affix ة,] signifies a large, or big, bucket. (S.) ―
-b2- And, applied to an udder (ضَرْع), Long: (S:) or pendent and wide; as also ↓ أَسْجَلُ : (K:) or this latter, applied to an udder, but only of a sheep or goat, wide, flaccid, and tossing about; striking the animal's hind legs, from behind. (ISh, TA.) ―
-b3- And, with ة, applied to a testicle (خُصْيَة), Flaccid and wide in the scrotum. (K.) ―
-b4- See also سَجْلٌ. ―
-b5- Also Hard, and strong. (K.) ＝
-A2- And A share, or portion: (K:) IAar says, it is of the measure فَعِيلٌ from سَجْلٌ meaning “ a full bucket ” [and likewise “ a share, or portion ”]; but, he adds, it does not please me. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
